name: uphealther
description: One command to set up, one to start and one to test the repository; CI runs the same scripts (ADR-044).

scripts.test: npm run test:diagrams && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:images
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:colours && npm run test:coverage && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run build
